items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: He was a colonel of the armies, and he thought I was a great man, and he used to send his private car to get me to come to the palace and play for the soldiers.

ctx.x: Did you ever get to know the great Haitian Fenlan, a great writer?

I knew of him. I didn't know him personally. Yes, I knew of him. He was a great writer. I met a lot of great men there. I met many Senators and Congressmen, and I knew at the time that I went there, Estimee was president, and he was responsible for the world's fair down there. They claimed that he absconded, but like -- oh, they put him in exile, because they said that he got so much money. Well, this happens in everything. But anyway, under him was Paul E. [crossed out] His last name sounds like this MA-GWAR. He…

And I never will forget, I was written up in every Haitian newspaper, front page news, because I used the circular breathing thing, and I held a note for about five minutes, and they wanted to know what God did I have in New York that could give me all of this breath, you know.
